units.contact_db: dB, mean paired cue / following blank band power
units.region_db: dB, equal-weight mean across sampled contacts and observed trials
units.glove: mean absolute change in sensor counts per nominal 40 ms step
units.glove_steps: number of within-window adjacent glove sample pairs per digit

summary: Display-locked within-record means. Adjacent windows share 300 ms. The participant chose when to move. The blank screen can include movement.
